denominator.definition: All housing units, occupied plus vacant, including seasonal and occasional-use units.

geography.note: The 2024 ACS release uses Connecticut planning regions and split Alaska census areas. These FIPS do not join exactly to the 2017 county boundaries; no name match or crosswalk is applied.

metrics.name: Vacant or seasonal share
metrics.description: Share of all housing units that are vacant, including seasonal and occasional-use units.

legacy_definitions.name: Homeownership rate (occupied households)
legacy_definitions.description: Former metric retained for the Data library; not the new default.
legacy_definitions.note: Denominator excludes vacant and seasonal units, so it is not comparable to the all-housing-units shares.

caveats: The denominator is all housing units, not occupied units. This is the definition change from the former occupied-household homeownership rate.
Vacant includes seasonal, recreational, and occasional-use units, so a high vacant share is not by itself a measure of available housing.
ACS values are 5-year estimates for 2020-2024 with sampling error. Derived-share margins of error require the ACS ratio/proportion approximation and must not be computed by dividing published MOEs.
Shares are computed from unrounded counts; values displayed to one decimal may not sum exactly to 100.0.
